title: The Junkyard
content: Anyone ever dreamt of an area that looks like a junkyard? I consider it to be part of mallworld because it had the same vividness and vibe as other Mallworld dreams. Started with a large pile of crunched up motorcycle parts, then larger cars. There is a shantytown nearby, made of tents of very faded old wood boards and rusted metal and such. The area looks like maybe an industrial district of irl Los Amgeles but mostly flat dirt lots. There is some sort of small shop selling cold drinks, souvenirs, and even has a greenhouse with plants for sale. Music of some sort playing in the background quietly. There were abandoned big box stores along a highway in a more forested area, full of moss and greenery growing along the ground. There was some sort of landslide at night near a river.
